castVote(uint256,uint8).details: Enforces 1 vote per address, checks active voting window, and allowlist if enabled

params.proposalId: The ID of the target proposal
params.support: VoteType enum choice: 0 = Against, 1 = For, 2 = Abstain

params._allowlistEnabled: Whether voting is initially restricted to allowlisted wallets
params._defaultQuorum: Minimum total votes required to pass a proposal by default

createProposal(string,string,uint32,uint.details: Only callable by the contract owner. Times are Unix timestamps in seconds.

params.description: Detailed proposal markdown or plain text
params.endTime: Unix timestamp when voting concludes (must be > startTime)
params.quorum: Minimum total votes required for this proposal (0 = simple majority only)
params.startTime: Unix timestamp when voting begins (must be >= current block.timestamp)
params.title: Short title of the proposal

returns.proposalId: The ID of the freshly created proposal

finalizeProposal(uint256).details: Permissionless: anyone can trigger finalization to settle proposal outcome

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to finalize

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.status: True to allowlist, false to revoke

params.enabled: True to restrict voting to allowlisted addresses only

returns._0: ProposalState enum representing current lifecycle state

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

allowlist(address).notice: Registered voters mapping when allowlist is active

allowlistEnabled().notice: Global toggle for voter allowlist (false = open to all wallets)

castVote(uint256,uint8).notice: Casts a single vote for a specified proposal

defaultQuorum().notice: Default quorum required for new proposals if not overridden

finalizeProposal(uint256).notice: Finalizes a proposal once its voting window has closed

getProposalVotes(uint256).notice: Quick getter for vote counts and total participation

getReceipt(uint256,address).notice: Checks if an address has voted on a proposal and their choice

receipts(uint256,address).notice: Voter receipts by proposal ID and voter address

setAllowlist(address[],bool).notice: Adds or removes multiple addresses from voter allowlist

setAllowlistEnabled(bool).notice: Enables or disables voter allowlist restriction

setDefaultQuorum(uint32).notice: Updates the default quorum applied to subsequent proposals

state(uint256).notice: Computes dynamic current state of a proposal
